_README: Curated ground truth. Fill from: questions/<scene>.pdf (answer images), VLA-3D per-scene object lists (boxes), provided .ply target trajectories. Units: meters, map frame. One entry per question, same order as questions.json.

numerical.q: How many pillows are on the bed?

object_reference.q: Find the bedside table farthest from the window.
Find the picture above the suitcase furthest from the floor.

instruction_following.q: Go to the bedside table closest to the window and stop at the chair closest to the TV.
First, go near the bedside table closest to the bench, then take the path between the TV and the bed to the picture closest to the TV.
